marks.gloss_en: erased paper: enough to wrap around a small flask of perfume
eye-paint: enough to paint one eye
חבל נמי ליחייב כדי לעשות תלאי לנפה ולכברה -- rope too should make one liable at the measure of a loop for a sifter or a sieve [as reed grass does]
כיון דחריק במנא לא עבדי אינשי -- since it cuts into the vessel, people do not make [such a loop of rope]
והתניא כגרוגרת -- but a baraita teaches [the measure of fat is] a dried fig!
אידי ואידי חד שיעורא הוא -- this and that are one measure (= p_sela_grogeret_chad_shiura)
the baraita: hard palm leaves -- enough to make an ear for an Egyptian wicker basket
ורמינהו: המוציא נייר חלק, אם יש בו כדי לכתוב שתי אותיות חייב -- the blank-paper baraita gives two [plain] letters, against 'two letters of a tax receipt'
מאי שתי אותיות? שתי אותיות של קשר מוכסין -- the blank-paper baraita's two letters are a tax receipt's (= p_rs_otiyot_kesher)
שתי אותיות דידן ובית אחיזה, דהיינו קשר מוכסין -- two of our letters plus a place to hold it, which together are a tax receipt (= p_rava_otiyot_didan)
the mishna: paper -- [one is liable for] enough to write a tax receipt on it
a baraita: one who carries out erased paper or a repaid note -- if its blank part has room to write two letters, he is liable; if not, exempt
the first tanna: one who carries out a tax receipt before he showed it to the tax collector is liable
the first tanna: one who carries out a promissory note before he repaid it is liable
Abaye: here they disagree over one who admits a note he wrote -- whether it must be ratified
